assertion.objects: For the original beta caller with t=a/beta: the original r5 and final finite-twist primitive realization, and U_f and the Kato dual V^vee.

assertion.quantifiers: For each such pair of representations.
assertion.uniformity: No quantitative bound on a field, level or exceptional set is asserted.
assertion.normalizations: The same arithmetic-Frobenius convention and fixed compatible coefficient embedding are used for each pair.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The theorem does not identify arbitrary nonsimple extensions from their traces.
assertion.limit_order: First obtain good-prime characteristic polynomials from the earlier source application. Apply Lemma3.2 to semisimplifications. A representation whose semisimplification is one simple factor has composition length one, giving the actual isomorphism without assuming semisimplicity of all cohomology.
